raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Large AWEX weight updates can hang when the torch-npu compatibility shim forwards thousands of operations to one fused HCCL call, including repeated sends or receives for the same peer. Split the operations into matching rounds with at most one operation per direction and peer, preserving per-peer ordering and batching independent peers together. Keep the existing grouped-P2P version gate and return every round's work handle.

## Related Issue

No linked issue. Reproduced with torch-npu 2.10.0.post4 and awex-ascend 0.2.0.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `ascend` (the requested base)
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** None intended. Callers must wait on all returned work handles; the fused fallback can now return multiple handles for repeated-peer batches.

## Additional Context

- `python -m pytest tests/test_torch_npu_compat.py -q`: 5 passed, covering uneven peer counts, matching round indices, per-peer ordering, and unchanged single-round batches.
- `pre-commit run --all-files`: passed.
- NPU diagnostics: the original fused call hung at approximately 9,200 operations per rank; the patched path passed repeated transfers with exact received-value checks on 4 and 16 NPUs. The installed AWEX wrapper also passed.
- Full-model validation: two consecutive Qwen3.6-35B-A3B updates completed with batching enabled on eight training and eight inference ranks. All writers/readers passed both completion barriers and training continued.
- Transport-only benchmark: five measured repetitions after warmup, alternating individual and patched batched methods on 16 NPUs, showed 9.7–10.1x lower transfer time for patched batching with contiguous BF16 tensors of 1 KiB, 64 KiB, and 1 MiB. This excludes conversion, noncontiguous copyback, inference weight loading, and concurrent training; it is not an end-to-end update speedup claim.
- Remaining validation: multi-node transport, colocated transfers, and custom-stream asynchronous callers were not qualified. The patch affects the global NPU fused fallback; additional HCCL launches and work handles may affect other repeated-peer workloads.

     return GROUPED_P2P_FIXED_IN is None or version < Version(GROUPED_P2P_FIXED_IN)
 
 
+def _split_p2p_ops(p2p_op_list: list["P2POp"]) -> list[list["P2POp"]]:
+    """Keep one operation per direction and peer in each fused HCCL call."""
+    rounds: list[list[P2POp]] = []
+    counts: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
+    for op in p2p_op_list:
+        key = (op.op.__name__, op.peer)
+        index = counts.get(key, 0)
+        if index == len(rounds):
+            rounds.append([])
+        rounds[index].append(op)
+        counts[key] = index + 1
+    return rounds
+

 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 
 import signal
-from types import ModuleType
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
 
 import pytest
 
 from areal.utils import torch_npu_compat
 
 
+def test_split_p2p_ops_uneven_peers_preserves_matching_rounds():
+    """Each directed edge keeps its tensor order and agrees on round indices."""
+    sends = SimpleNamespace(__name__="isend")
+    recvs = SimpleNamespace(__name__="irecv")
+    edges = {(0, 2): 5, (0, 3): 2, (1, 2): 1, (1, 3): 4, (2, 0): 3}
+    schedules = {}
+    for rank in range(4):
+        ops = []
+        for (src, dst), count in edges.items():
+            for index in range(count):
+                if rank == src:
+                    ops.append(
+                        SimpleNamespace(op=sends, peer=dst, tensor=(src, dst, index))
+                    )
+                if rank == dst:
+                    ops.append(
+                        SimpleNamespace(op=recvs, peer=src, tensor=(src, dst, index))
+                    )
+        rounds = torch_npu_compat._split_p2p_ops(ops)
+        assert sum(map(len, rounds)) == len(ops)
+        for index, batch in enumerate(rounds):
+            keys = [(op.op.__name__, op.peer) for op in batch]
+            assert len(keys) == len(set(keys))
+            for op in batch:
+                assert op.tensor[2] == index
+                schedules[rank, op.tensor] = index
+    for (src, dst), count in edges.items():
+        for index in range(count):
+            assert (
+                schedules[src, (src, dst, index)] == schedules[dst, (src, dst, index)]
+            )
+
+
+def test_split_p2p_ops_unique_peers_keeps_one_batch():
+    """Warmup and mixed send/receive pairs need no extra HCCL calls."""
+    ops = [
+        SimpleNamespace(op=SimpleNamespace(__name__=direction), peer=peer)
+        for direction, peer in [("isend", 1), ("irecv", 1), ("isend", 2)]
+    ]
+    assert torch_npu_compat._split_p2p_ops(ops) == [ops]
+    assert torch_npu_compat._split_p2p_ops([]) == []
+
+
